target.count_event: completed legal future trick whose winning card is one of the target cards played by N

optimization.objective: maximum number of target-card tricks NS can guarantee from the time origin
optimization.strategy: legal NS plan using the public position and explicit given information
optimization.defense: all legal EW replies and hidden layouts consistent with public information
optimization.entries: only entries obtainable from the actual remaining cards; no hypothetical or cooperative entry
optimization.establishment_play: included within future play, never silently treated as already completed
not_metric: cards established after an assumed line

legacy_compatibility.existing_meaning: number of ready low-card tricks after the transition already given in the legacy exercise
legacy_compatibility.transport_envelope: low-card-structured-response-v1 is unchanged; only a new question ID is proposed
